prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: finished decorative background for the Coaching section of Willis Wee's established midnight pixel-art personal website.
Primary request: create a NEW sea-overlook coaching illustration with its entire narrative focal group on the RIGHT; the website will place a substantial reading panel over the LEFT half. Landscape canvas 1536 by 1024 pixels, 3:2.
Input images: Image 1 is a reference for the two adult peers, respectful personal space, notebook, lantern, coastal mood, and quality. Image 2 is a STYLE AND PALETTE reference for crisp detailed pixel-art scenery only. These are references, not images to duplicate or simply mirror.
Scene: a tranquil dark-blue coastal bay and layered distant headlands at late blue hour. On the RIGHT is a weathered wooden bench at a grassy rock overlook under the branches of a coastal tree anchored at the right edge. Two adult peers sit on the bench, seen from behind in a natural professional conversation. Willis has short dark hair, a plain navy T-shirt, khaki shorts and sneakers, and gestures gently toward the view. The other adult wears a dark hoodie and holds an open notebook on a knee. They sit upright, with a plainly visible generous empty gap between them—at least one seat-width of bench—with independent posture, no touching, no leaning toward each other. A small amber camping lantern rests on the ground between their feet. A canvas tote with a tiny sloth charm sits near the bench. Preserve the collegial, equal relationship.
Composition: horizon near 42% of image height. Keep BOTH complete people, the open notebook, lantern, and most of the bench concentrated within x=68% to 92% of the full canvas width and y=47% to 82% of its height. Main focal center around x=80%, y=64%. Moderate-size figures in a spacious landscape; no cropped heads or feet. Keep the left 58% naturally quiet with navy sky, sea and low-contrast headlands, continuous detailed scenery suitable behind an opaque reading panel. No empty solid-color rectangle and no artificial blank bands at top/bottom. A narrow rocky footpath enters from lower right; foreground grasses and rocks extend to every canvas edge.
Style/medium: handcrafted high-quality 16-bit pixel-art adventure-game background matching the reference website: crisp stepped contours, visibly square pixel clusters, restrained dithering, richly layered deep blues, nuanced pixel foliage and water. Organic pixel rendering, not smooth anime line art, not painterly, not vector, not low-poly, not photographic.
Lighting/mood: deep midnight navy, muted teal sea, a narrow subtle copper glow on the distant horizon, warm lantern pool that softly lights both peers. Calm thoughtful working conversation.
Constraints: exactly two adults; visibly generous personal space; no romantic body language; no visible faces, no text, no lettering, no logos, no watermark, no frame, no UI, no large moon, no spectacular bright sunset, no tent, desk, workshop or city. The right-side placement is essential.
processing: WebP quality 92, effort 6; no resizing or creative edits
integration: Homepage #coaching, panel left and artwork focal group right. Existing coaching-lantern-bench-v1.webp retained for coaching.html.
